subject.title: fix(ci): include runtime resources in build artifact

question: Should OpenClaw accept this repository-owned pack-and-smoke script as the new `dist-runtime-build` artifact producer?
rationale: The review found no concrete patch defect, but the diff changes CI artifact production and runtime smoke behavior that downstream proof workflows depend on.

options.title: Land with artifact proof
options.body: Merge once the reviewed head or merge queue keeps `build-artifacts` green with pack, manifest, ACP import, and Gateway `/readyz` proof.

options.title: Refresh proof after any script change
options.body: If the workflow or artifact script changes again before merge, require a fresh artifact-producing CI run before accepting the risk.

options.title: Pause for a smaller producer
options.body: Keep the PR open if maintainers want to split the smoke script from the artifact producer before landing.

recommendation.title: Land with artifact proof
recommendation.body: Merge once the reviewed head or merge queue keeps `build-artifacts` green with pack, manifest, ACP import, and Gateway `/readyz` proof.
